introduction: Discover the Tempest Court and follow Zieflia's family rescue, Aurilium's palace key, Ixteal's heart and the five Wind Dukes' Maelstrom essences. Choose how to spend each fragment on Cloudseeker or Fearfrost's hammer. Seven outcomes explain exact acceptance and optional source preparation; active, ready accounting is required.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is required for zone discovery, visible NPC encounters, journal progress and new daily credit. The first visit is its own zone discovery achievement. Current material checks and journal reading do not award credit.

The ordinary boundary is the Plane of Air courtyard up to the Cloudwalk. Most local routes use air-plane terrain: entering requires flight or levitation; moving horizontally from it requires flight, while levitation supports up/down. The acting mount must meet the movement requirements. Encountered actors can move away from declared starting rooms.

Use ENTER on the actual planar portals: Cloudwalk to mist fortress and back; smoke fortress to its prison tower and back; smoke to ice-and-steel fortress and back; mist-tower top to palace top and back. These eight portals have unlimited charges. The top of the palace still has a locked downward door requiring Aurilium's key on the ordinary approach.

For Zieflia, find and open the smoke wall to Galzron. His smoke key opens her northern force cell without a normal-unlock break chance. Then give it to her for the medallion; that exchange consumes the key and retires her. Return the medallion to the current Al'Hajib in the mist courtyard for the sapphire eyepiece. The older Al'Hajib is an equivalent inactive source identity.

Aurilium wants frost from Ecthius, smoke from Galzron and mist from Si'Ciltron: one of each exact kind. The barracks frost key belongs to the second following aerial servant, and can break on normal unlocking. The persistent rewarded palace key fits the downward entrance; its receipt does not prove personal kills, unchaining Aurilium or defeating Akadi.

Darthikya accepts Ixteal's heart for frost gauntlets. Ixteal and several recipients have nominal rare mobile resets, which ordinary unforced resets currently skip. Starting-room clues, global limits, current custody and admitted reset generations govern real availability.

Chan requires five distinct Wind Duke essences. The Dukes start together in the mist fortress guest room, not the final palace; four wear their proof at the neck while Emoniel carries his. Chan starts inside the palace and is naturally invisible. Find and perceive the actual recipient before addressed dialogue or delivery.

Chan's fragment is consumed by two different requests. Cloudseeker needs eight exact wind relics plus a fragment; Fearfrost needs a fragment plus Frostbite, Mistweave and Thrym's token. A prior fragment receipt cannot spend the same object twice. Both independent rewards can be recorded if you obtain separate supplies; no permanent exclusive branch is invented.

Cloudseeker materials come from Winterhaven's Lancer bundle, Lair of the Gibberling King, the Hall of Knighthood, the Charcoal Palace, IceCrag Castle, Akadi, the Jade Empire and the Savannah Watcher. The same wisp and katana have other consumers. Use each item's exact name and source hint; personal completion of those foreign stories is optional when proof is supplied.

All native offerings here are complete exact bundles of loose carried items, without coin fees. Wearing or holding a weapon, cloak, boots, token or essence does not satisfy the native offering search. Optional source/history aids are not hidden prerequisites, and earlier receipts do not restore consumed objects.

ASK/TELL topics explain lore without awarding separate keyword achievements. The yan/yan-c-bin MA family is still addressed dialogue, with a room audience. Native si'ciltron topics are explained in prose because structured topic tokens cannot contain the apostrophe.

Seven named outcomes cover all eight native recipes. The two Al'Hajib recipients share one outcome. Rescue and Cloudseeker retire their recipients in reset mode zero and remain story-only. The five remaining candidate units still need evidence of current access, supply and player suitability before daily assignment.

The palace epic rune uses the existing committed epic-touch result and its accounting/group/reset policy. It is separate from a key receipt, a personal Akadi defeat or full liberation. Active accounting refuses legacy reset item issuance without an owned generation, so declared loot is not guaranteed replenishment.

The sapphire eyepiece has a native upgrade promise and four unused gem-set prototypes, but no established active upgrade recipe or source. Divine sparks, extra encoded Air Attack prototypes, sealed rare-load rooms and quasi-plane dead ends remain integration or builder-intent findings, not invented story terminals.

The courtyard cloud portal declares the Troll Hills as its destination but has command zero and zero charges; do not depend on it for ENTER return. The eight upper-cloud lightning objects lack the movement-trigger bit; restoring that hazard needs builder intent and balance qualification. Normal return through the Plane of Air boundary remains a separately qualified route.

contacts.name: Zieflia
contacts.description: Zieflia starts in the northern force cell. Give the smoke key for her medallion and departure; the receipt does not implement a traveling escort.

contacts.name: Al'Hajib
contacts.description: The currently reset Al'Hajib starts in the mist courtyard. Ask zieflia or medallion. Supplied medallions fit; the gem-upgrade promise lacks an established active implementation.

contacts.name: Al'Hajib
contacts.description: The older Al'Hajib has the same medallion exchange but no active declared spawn. It is an equivalent recipient, not another required family rescue.

contacts.name: the north wind
contacts.description: The north wind starts on the ethereal Cloudwalk. Ask seeker for all nine materials. The source keyword si'ciltron also works in native dialogue; punctuation prevents exposing it as a structured topic. Addressed yan dialogue speaks to the room.

contacts.name: Aurilium
contacts.description: Aurilium starts in the Cloudwalk near lightning. Ask key or akadi, or the native si'ciltron keyword, about his brothers. Three different essences yield a key; no unchaining is recorded.

contacts.name: Darthikya, the Githyanki Hunter
contacts.description: Darthikya starts in the mist fortress and hunts Ixteal. His native recipe accepts the exact heart for frost gauntlets despite blank exchange prose.

contacts.name: Chan, the Dark Tempest
contacts.description: Chan starts in the palace but is naturally invisible. Ask maelstrom after actually perceiving her. Five distinct essences yield one fragment; no new visibility-state change is asserted from narration.

contacts.name: Fearfrost
contacts.description: Fearfrost starts in the palace. Ask blessing or maelstrom. His hammer exchange competes with Cloudseeker for the actual fragment and requires three exact foreign proofs.

contacts.name: Si'Ciltron
contacts.description: Si'Ciltron starts behind the closed mist door in his war chamber, carrying the essence of mist. The real return is east.

contacts.name: Galzron
contacts.description: Galzron starts behind the smoke wall with both the smoke essence and the key to Zieflia's northern cell. The wall's two reset sides have different secret states.

contacts.name: Ecthius
contacts.description: Ecthius starts in the cold ice-and-steel chamber with the frost essence. The barracks follower carries the office key, whose normal use can break it.

contacts.name: Ixteal
contacts.description: Ixteal starts on the Cloudwalk with his heart; declared rare admission and current custody are separate from the later accepted delivery.

contacts.name: an aerial servant
contacts.description: Aerial servants occur throughout the court. The steel frost key belongs to the second following servant in the barracks, not every servant or the leading guard.

contacts.name: Amophar, the Wind Duke
contacts.description: Amophar starts in the mist guest room with the neck-worn essence of the Four Storms. Rare admission and roaming can change availability.

contacts.name: Icosiol, the Wind Duke
contacts.description: Icosiol starts in the mist guest room with the neck-worn essence of the Winds of Fate; it differs from the other four kinds.

contacts.name: Zosiel, the Wind Duke
contacts.description: Zosiel starts in the mist guest room with the neck-worn essence of the Great Maelstrom; it differs from the fragment Chan creates.

contacts.name: Emoniel, the Wind Duke
contacts.description: Emoniel starts in the mist guest room carrying the essence of the Boundless Blue; it is an inventory grant rather than neck equipment.

contacts.name: Uriel, the Wind Duke
contacts.description: Uriel starts in the mist guest room with the neck-worn essence of the Unseen Breeze; Cloudseeker is a different later reward.

contacts.name: Akadi
contacts.description: Akadi starts in the central palace with the north-wind cloak, an imported epic rune, weapons and a bound wind dagger. Her defeat or epic settlement is separate from delivery receipts.

contacts.name: Yan-C-Bin
contacts.description: Yan-C-Bin has a declared load in the sealed rare-load room. His conflict with Akadi is lore; active dispersal and a restoration endpoint remain unqualified.

contacts.name: Ellacarzel, Angel of the Clouds
contacts.description: Ellacarzel is declared in the other sealed rare-load room with Yan-C-Bin. There is no local native delivery or configured ordinary dispersal route for the angel.

stories.title: Zieflia's rescue medallion
stories.summary: Find Galzron beyond the smoke wall for the smoke key. It unlocks Zieflia's northern force cell; normal use does not consume it. Give the key to Zieflia for her medallion and her departure. The separate southern cell has no specified key. This disappearing-recipient outcome is story-only under reset mode zero.

steps.text: Carry a key of pure smoke
steps.hint: Galzron starts in the smoky chamber behind the smoke wall and carries both this key and the essence of smoke. Use the key at the northern force bars, then offer it to Zieflia in that cell. Normal unlocking leaves the key; this accepted exchange consumes it. Recover the exact kind into loose carried inventory before offering it. Supplied matching proof is accepted; this check does not record first recovery, a personal kill, source or successful access.
